compatibility_rules.rule: Latex over latex requires clean, sound existing coating
compatibility_rules.risk: Adhesion failure if existing paint is chalking, peeling, or contaminated
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Test adhesion with tape pull; clean thoroughly; spot prime problem areas

compatibility_rules.rule: Repairs must be primed before finish coat
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Apply spot primer to all repairs; allow full dry before finish

compatibility_rules.rule: Higher sheen over lower sheen requires proper prep
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Light sand or degloss existing surface; ensure uniform absorption

risk_notes: Unknown existing coating (oil-based) requires adhesion test before proceeding
Extreme color changes may require additional coats or tinted primer
High-humidity conditions extend dry time between coats
assumptions: All materials are standard interior latex products
Coverage rates assume smooth to light-textured drywall
Paint quality tier matches quality level (builder grade for QL-3, mid-grade for QL-4, premium for QL-5)
uncertainty_flags: Actual repair material consumption varies significantly by condition
Spread rates vary by application method and painter technique
